items.html: And with this it will not be difficult for you, if it appears in the Zohar in the aforementioned place that the coupling is at the time of the dawn, and in another place in the Zohar it is implied that the coupling is at the time of the falling on the face (Ne'ilat Apayim) after the Amidah. Know that both statements are true, for the coupling of the darkness of the morning (Kadruta DeTzafra) is the coupling of Jacob with Leah, and that of the falling on the face is Jacob with Rachel.
